overview.caption: Figure 1: Prototype overview. Prototype structure for VR learning of the Pavilion of Prince Teng with PAs. For adaptive role-switching, the system switches roles based on user input, including voice, tone, and the appearance of the agents. For adaptive action-switching, the system determines and displays appropriate actions based on model output.

Conversation Module.function_description: Handles the core conversational interaction between the user and the pedagogical agent, including speech processing and response generation.
Conversation Module.technical_details: Uses OpenAI Whisper for speech-to-text, GPT-4o for model processing, and Microsoft Azure API for text-to-speech. Integrates location, background knowledge, and scene description.

io_signature.input_type: Speech (user input), Contextual data (location, background, scene)

outgoing.data_flow_meaning: Transcribed user input for role determination
Agent response text for action determination

Adaptive Role-Switching Module.function_description: Dynamically selects and transitions the pedagogical agent's role based on user input and context.
Adaptive Role-Switching Module.technical_details: Uses GPT-4o to classify the appropriate role (e.g., Prince Teng, Wang Bo, Archaeologist) based on user questions and role descriptions. Updates tone, voice, and appearance.

end

Adaptive Action-Switching Module.function_description: Determines and executes appropriate non-verbal actions for the pedagogical agent based on its response.
Adaptive Action-Switching Module.technical_details: Uses GPT-4o to select actions (pointing, expressive, descriptive, character-specific) based on the agent's response text and action descriptions.
